public_health_question.v: What were the food and person-to-person sources and transmission routes of two Norwalk-like virus outbreaks, in Alaska and Wisconsin?

ev.q: This report presents investigations of a foodborne NLV outbreak in Alaska and person-to-person transmission in Wisconsin.
Norwalk-like viruses (NLVs) are the most common cause of epidemic gastroenteritis in the United States
This report presents investigations of a foodborne NLV outbreak in Alaska and person-to-person transmission in Wisconsin.

equity.level_reason: Only age is mentioned, as a general statement that all ages are affected; residence-hall living and food-handling jobs are exposure settings, not social-position framing.

ev.q: Persons of all ages are affected because previous infection confers only short-term immunity

notes: The OR of 42.7 is computed from a 2x2 table and is not labelled as a model. 'Associated strongly' is treated as a CI judged against 1, which makes the inference 'CIs and tests' and the procedure a CI vs fixed value test. The inference method for the CI is not stated.
